item.title: Yamagata Hanagasa Matsuri: The Flower Hat Festival — Guide
item.description: The Hanagasa Matsuri (August 5–7) is one of Tohoku’s great summer festivals — over 10,000 dancers parade through central Yamagata City wearing broad straw hats decorated with safflower blossoms (benibana), waving the hats in graceful choreographed sequences to the driving rhythm of the ‘Yassho Makashow’ chant. The safflower blossoms decorating the hats have been cultivated in Yamagata for centuries as a precious dye crop. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Yamagata City, Yamagata Hours Evenings, August 5–7 Admission Free to watch from the roadside Time needed 2–3 hours Best time August 5–7 (fixed dates) Highlights Over 10,000 dancers waving flower-decorated hats.
